This edge must not be read as approval of the note.

Subscription runs through the Republic platform with a $50 minimum and a $5,000 initial cap; tokens are locked from resale or transfer for 12 months and thereafter tradable only on the Republic Secondary Market ‘with other investors’.

OpenDeal Inc., the Republic group parent, is the manager of RepublicX LLC; the Form D/A adds a note on intercompany payments to OpenDeal Inc. subsidiaries. The intended post-lockup venue is the Republic Secondary Market, an affiliate venue.

RepublicX LLC’s entire filing history is a Form D and Form D/A under Rule 506(c). There is no Form C, C/A, C-U or C-AR, no registration statement and no periodic report — yet the product was marketed as a Regulation Crowdfunding offering ‘open to all’, and Reg CF requires a Form C before any offer is made.

‘Access to Tokenized SECZ is restricted to holders who meet the onboarding requirements of Securities Markets, LLC, a SEC registered and FINRA member broker dealer’, with onboarding, KYC/AML verification and jurisdictional eligibility checks. Eligible U.S. investors are the target market, which inverts the usual tokenized-equity geofence.

S-4 effective 2026-06-05, 8-A12B 2026-06-30, S-1 filed 2026-07-31 with EFFECT 2026-08-07. Uniquely in this dataset the tokenized form is described inside a registration statement, i.e. under Securities Act liability, rather than only in press releases. No relief for the tokenized form was located.

The group’s own SEC-registered broker-dealer and alternative trading system ‘approved for digital asset securities primary and secondary market trading’ gates access: ‘Access to Tokenized SECZ is restricted to holders who meet the onboarding requirements of Securities Markets, LLC, a SEC registered and FINRA member broker dealer’ (publicly known as Securitize Markets, LLC).
